name: Gemazocine
summary: Gemazocine (R-15,497), also known as cyclogemine, is a non-selective opioid antagonist of the benzomorphan class. It may have partial agonist properties at some of the opioid receptors, such as at the kappa receptor (as it induces dysphoric effects in humans), but seems to be generally antagonistic in its actions.

pharmacology.text: Gemazocine (R-15,497), also known as cyclogemine, is a non-selective opioid antagonist of the benzomorphan class. It may have partial agonist properties at some of the opioid receptors, such as at the kappa receptor (as it induces dysphoric effects in humans), but seems to be generally antagonistic in its actions.

uses.en: It was never marketed and is known only from research.
uses.zh: 它從未上市，只見於研究。
uses.zhHans: 它从未上市，只见于研究。

sideEffects.en: It is reported to cause dysphoria, an unpleasant low or uneasy mood, in people, most likely through kappa opioid receptors.
sideEffects.zh: 據報告，它在人體會引起煩躁不安，也就是不愉快、低落或不安的情緒，很可能是透過 κ 類鴉片受體所致。
sideEffects.zhHans: 据报告，它在人体会引起烦躁不安，也就是不愉快、低落或不安的情绪，很可能是通过 κ 类鸦片受体所致。

fact.en: Gemazocine is a benzomorphan, a trimmed-down version of the morphine skeleton with some rings removed. The better known painkiller pentazocine belongs to the same family.
fact.zh: Gemazocine 屬於苯并嗎啡烷類，是把嗎啡骨架拿掉部分環後的簡化版本。較為人知的止痛藥噴他佐辛也屬於這一家族。
fact.zhHans: Gemazocine 属于苯并吗啡烷类，是把吗啡骨架拿掉部分环后的简化版本。较为人知的止痛药喷他佐辛也属于这一家族。
